methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages fetched directly and verified for Originality.ai (originality.ai/pricing — all prices confirmed exact), Winston AI (gowinston.ai/pricing — all prices confirmed exact), Sapling (sapling.ai/pricing + sapling.ai/security — prices and HIPAA/SOC2/GDPR confirmed), and GPTZero compliance (gptzero.me/privacy-and-security — SOC2 Type II + GDPR confirmed). GPTZero, ZeroGPT, and Copyleaks pricing pages are dynamically rendered or returned HTTP 403; for these, only figures corroborated by two or more independent 2026 review sources (spotsaas, aidetectplus, fritz.ai, Capterra, tryleap.ai) were retained. KEY CORRECTION: ZeroGPT's plan ladder was updated from a stale Capterra listing (Pro $8.29 / 'Zero Compromise' $9.99) to the current 2026 structure (Pro $9.99 / Plus $19.99 / Max $26.99) corroborated across multiple recent reviews; the 'Zero Compromise' tier no longer exists. Scribbr and Turnitin confirmed free-only and quote-only respectively via multiple 2026 sources; Turnitin monthlyUsd kept null (no published self-serve price). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Originality.ai
vendors.provenance: Fetched originality.ai/pricing on 2026-06-15; all plan prices confirmed EXACT directly. Compliance certifications not stated on the pricing page; security page returned 404 so all compliance left null.

plans.name: Pay As You Go
plans.notes: One-time purchase of $30 for 3,000 credits (1 credit = 100 words). Credits expire 2 years from purchase. Includes AI Checker, Plagiarism Checker, Readability, Grammar, Fact Checker, 30-day scan history, WordPress Plugin, Chrome Extension. Confirmed exact on live page.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 2,000 credits/month. Annual billing at $12.95/month ($155.40/yr, saves $24). Includes file uploads (DOCX, PDF), full site scans, team management, tag scans, Chrome extension. Additional seats $9.95/mo (annual $8.62/mo). Confirmed exact on live page.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 15,000 credits/month. Annual billing at $136.58/month ($1,638.96/yr, saves $509). All Pro features plus dedicated CSM, 1-hour priority support, 365-day scan history, API access. Additional seats $24.95/mo (annual $19.04/mo). Confirmed exact on live page.

keyFeatures: AI content detection + plagiarism in one scan
enrichment.provenance: Fetched originality.ai/pricing directly on 2026-06-15; all three plan prices confirmed exact. No forever-free tier exists (freeTier false). Compliance all null (security page 404).

plans.name: Premium

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: 500,000 words/month. Annual billing ~$24.99/month. API access included. Up to 250-file batch uploads. Team collaboration, custom LMS integration. Credits do not roll over. Price corroborated.
